results.title: AI in drug discovery: Artificial Intelligence in Science
results.content: ## AI in drug discovery. Artificial intelligence (AI) promises to de-risk the discovery process for new drugs. AI will change drug discovery. As AI is integrated into ever-more steps in drug discovery, its main impact is in selecting experiments with the best chance of success, thereby de-risking the discovery process. Explainable AI could have a major impact on the steps in drug discovery where AI is not yet widely used. ### The promise of AI in drug discovery. How much of an impact on drug discovery should be expected from AI? AI in drug discovery is not a new phenomenon. Besides molecular docking and toxicity prediction, which were already staples of state-of-the-art drug discovery workflows, small biotech companies are piloting many new ways of using AI. The datasets used for training in drug discovery also differ significantly from most well-known AI problems like computer vision or natural language processing.
